description: Retrieve saved reviews for a STEP file, optionally filtered by an entity, free-text search, or tags. Pass the current ArtifactRef from Geometry inspect; its revision is used to mark each returned record stale or current. Each record returns one artifact reference, its entity IDs and the ID scheme; use these together when handing an annotation to another tool. An entity filter matches only reviews written against the supplied revision, because a face ID denotes different geometry in a different revision; text and tag filters are not scoped that way. Use early in a conversation to restore persistent context about a part. Uses the supplied artifact revision to mark saved records stale; it does not open the artifact or require shared filesystem access.

revision.description: sha256 revision of the artifact, copied from a Geometry inspect result. It is the anchor every record is stored against, and recall compares it to mark records stale.

units.description: Spatial unit of the source file, echoed from inspect.

uri.description: Artifact location: a URI such as file:///parts/curved-sector.step, or a plain filesystem path such as /parts/curved-sector.step. Both address the same records, because a path is normalised to a file: URL before anything is stored against it. A relative path resolves against this server working directory. Records are grouped by it; without a URI the revision alone is the key.

entity_id.description: If set, only return reviews that include this entity (e.g. 'face:2' or a component-scoped 'component:wheel-axle/face:0').

search.description: Free-text match across feature names and note bodies (case-insensitive).

tags.description: Only return reviews carrying all these tags (without '#').
